This recovers TR11 and its temperate bound with the original constant. For the Laplace continuity step fix u ∈C◦and write λi = suμi, λ = suν on the one-point compactification. Their total masses are eventually bounded by some M, and the limit mass is bounded by M as well, increasing M if necessary. The functions sv and constants retain their exact multiplication and separating properties after readout. If h is continuous there and a finite linear combination a of this algebra satisfies ∥h −a∥∞≤δ, then
Z h dλi − Z h dλ ≤2Mδ +
Z a dλi − Z a dλ .
